summary: The senior member sizes you up: {senior member} asks you to stop by in your first month and to back them on a procedural vote.
realLife: One life: In 1967 the first Black woman in the Texas Senate won respect by befriending conservatives, among them the chamber's most powerful member, and was named outstanding freshman. Another: He took his Assembly seat at 23, expected by the old members to keep quiet.
gates: {senior member} holds power over committees or the calendar.
weights: How far your stances are from theirs.
Traits that are diligent or that charm.
choices: say you will decide on the merits
ask what they can do for your district's bill

branches.when: you are the first of your kind, or the youngest
branches.then: The room expects you to keep quiet, and a first floor speech changes that.
Months later you are asked to be vice-chair of the committee that draws districts.
You know their bill better than they do and say so politely. They respect it or resent it, by their traits.
